company.name: Nimbus
company.tagline: Your entire business in the cloud.
company.about: Nimbus provides a unified suite of cloud applications designed to run your entire business from a single platform. We help organizations of all sizes streamline their operations, from sales and marketing to finance and HR. Our integrated ecosystem eliminates data silos and empowers teams to collaborate seamlessly.

refund.title: 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee & Refund Policy
refund.summary: Nimbus offers a 100% full money-back guarantee for all new subscriptions within the first 30 days of purchase. Applies to both monthly and annual plans across all 24 products. Submit a ticket in admin console to initiate; refunded to original payment method within 5-7 business days.
refund.applies_to: All products, both monthly and annual plans
refund.how_to_claim: Submit a billing support ticket through the administrator console

free_trial.title: 14-Day Free Trial Policy
free_trial.summary: All Nimbus products include a 14-day free trial on Starter and Professional plans. No credit card required. Full feature access during trial.

billing.title: Billing & Payment Policy
billing.summary: Billed in advance monthly or annually. Annual billing offers a 20% discount. Accepts Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and ACH transfers.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.summary: Cancel anytime in admin dashboard with no fees or lock-in contracts. Access continues until the end of the current billing cycle.

sla.title: SLA & Uptime Policy
sla.summary: 99.9% uptime SLA for Professional and Enterprise plans with service credit compensation for downtime.

security.title: Security & Compliance
security.summary: SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 27001 compliant, GDPR compliant. TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest. US and EU (Frankfurt) data residency available.

support.title: Customer Support Policy
support.summary: 24/7 community, email and chat support. Priority phone support (4h response) for Professional plans; dedicated technical account manager (1h response) for Enterprise.

products.name: Nimbus CRM
products.tagline: Build relationships and close deals faster.
products.summary: Nimbus CRM is the foundational hub for your sales team, offering comprehensive contact management and sales pipeline visibility. Track every interaction and forecast revenue with precision.

addOns.name: Extra Storage
addOns.desc: Add additional file storage for customer documents and attachments.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus CRM cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus CRM starts with a Free tier for small teams, while paid plans range from $15 per user monthly for Starter to $45 per user monthly for Professional. Enterprise pricing is custom.

specificFaqs.question: Can I import my existing contacts?
specificFaqs.answer: Absolutely, you can easily import contacts from CSV files or directly from other popular CRM platforms using our migration wizard.

products.name: Nimbus Leads
products.tagline: Automate outreach and engage your best prospects.
products.summary: Nimbus Leads empowers your sales development reps with automated outreach sequences, a built-in dialer, and intelligent lead scoring. Connect with the right prospects at the perfect time.

addOns.name: Additional Call Minutes
addOns.desc: Purchase extra VoIP calling minutes for high-volume outbound teams.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Leads cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Leads has a Free tier, a Starter plan at $25 per user monthly, a Professional plan at $65 per user monthly, and custom Enterprise pricing.

specificFaqs.question: Does the dialer support international calling?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, our built-in dialer supports calling to over 100 countries, with rates varying by destination region.

products.name: Nimbus Quote
products.tagline: Create proposals and close deals with ease.
products.summary: Nimbus Quote is a complete CPQ and proposal solution that accelerates your sales cycle. Generate accurate quotes, collaborate in deal rooms, and capture secure e-signatures.

addOns.name: Premium E-Signatures
addOns.desc: Advanced identity verification and compliance tracking for highly regulated industries.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Quote cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Quote offers a Free tier, Starter at $20 per user monthly, Professional at $50 per user monthly, and custom pricing for Enterprise.

specificFaqs.question: Are the e-signatures legally binding?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, our e-signatures comply with major international laws including ESIGN, UETA, and eIDAS.

products.name: Nimbus Campaigns
products.tagline: Automate emails and drive customer journeys effortlessly.
products.summary: Nimbus Campaigns is a powerful email marketing and automation platform designed to help you engage leads and close deals. Build personalized journeys that deliver the right message at exactly the right time.
keyFeatures: Drag-and-drop email builder with responsive templates
Visual automation journey builder with conditional logic
Advanced list segmentation and dynamic content
A/B testing for subject lines and email content

addOns.name: Dedicated IP
addOns.desc: Improve your sender reputation with a dedicated IP address for your campaigns.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Campaigns cost?
specificFaqs.answer: We offer a Free tier for basic needs, a Starter plan at $15 per user per month, a Professional plan at $45 per user per month, and custom Enterprise pricing.

specificFaqs.question: Can I import my existing contact lists?
specificFaqs.answer: Absolutely, you can easily import contacts via CSV or sync them directly from Nimbus CRM and other supported integrations.

products.name: Nimbus Social
products.tagline: Manage, monitor, and measure your social presence.
products.summary: Nimbus Social is an all-in-one social media management tool that lets you schedule posts, listen to brand conversations, and analyze performance across networks. Streamline your social strategy from a single intuitive dashboard.
keyFeatures: Bulk scheduling and automated queue management
Multi-network support including LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook
Social listening and brand mention monitoring

addOns.name: Extra Social Profiles
addOns.desc: Add more social media accounts to your workspace as your brand grows.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Social cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Social includes a Free tier, a Starter plan for $20 per user per month, a Professional plan for $50 per user per month, and custom Enterprise packages.

specificFaqs.question: Which social networks do you support?
specificFaqs.answer: We currently support scheduling and monitoring for Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, and YouTube.

products.name: Nimbus Sites
products.tagline: Build high-converting landing pages and websites instantly.
products.summary: Nimbus Sites is a visual website and landing page builder designed to help marketers capture more leads. Create beautiful, mobile-optimized pages with integrated forms and native A/B testing.
keyFeatures: Dynamic text replacement for personalized experiences
Built-in lead capture forms and pop-ups
Custom domain mapping and SSL certificates

addOns.name: Additional Visitor Capacity
addOns.desc: Scale your bandwidth seamlessly during high-traffic marketing campaigns.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Sites cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Pricing starts with a Free tier, moves to $25 per user per month for Starter, $60 for Professional, and custom pricing for Enterprise.

specificFaqs.question: Can I use my own custom domain?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, custom domain mapping with free SSL certificates is included on all paid plans.

products.name: Nimbus Books
products.tagline: Smart double entry accounting for growing businesses
products.summary: Nimbus Books simplifies your financial management with automated workflows and real-time insights. Stay compliant and ready for tax season with our intuitive double-entry accounting software.

addOns.name: Dedicated Bookkeeper
addOns.desc: Monthly reconciliation and review by a certified Nimbus partner.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Books cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Books starts with a Free tier for basic needs, while our Starter plan is $15 per user per month. Professional is $40 per user per month, and Enterprise pricing is customized to your needs.

specificFaqs.question: Can I invite my external accountant to Nimbus Books?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, all paid plans include a dedicated accountant role that allows your CPA to access your books without consuming a paid user seat.

products.name: Nimbus Invoice
products.tagline: Effortless invoicing and fast online payment collection
products.summary: Create professional invoices, set up recurring billing, and accept online payments in minutes. Nimbus Invoice helps you get paid faster and improves your cash flow.

addOns.name: Advanced Custom Domain
addOns.desc: Host your client payment portal on your own custom web address.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Invoice cost?
specificFaqs.answer: We offer a Free tier for up to 10 invoices a month. The Starter plan is $10 per user per month, Professional is $30 per user per month, and Enterprise is custom priced.

specificFaqs.question: Does Nimbus Invoice charge transaction fees?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus does not charge any additional transaction fees, but standard processing rates from your connected payment gateway will still apply.

products.name: Nimbus Expense
products.tagline: Streamline corporate spending and employee reimbursement workflows
products.summary: Control company spending with smart corporate cards and automated expense reporting. Nimbus Expense eliminates manual data entry and accelerates employee reimbursements.

addOns.name: Global Reimbursements
addOns.desc: Reimburse employees in over 130 local currencies without exorbitant FX fees.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Expense cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Expense is free for basic receipt tracking. Starter is $15 per user per month, Professional is $35 per user per month, and Enterprise is custom priced based on your organization size.

specificFaqs.question: Are the corporate cards credit or prepaid cards?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus corporate cards are charge cards that draw directly from your connected business bank account, meaning no interest charges or credit checks are required.

products.name: Nimbus People
products.tagline: Centralize your workforce and streamline employee management.
products.summary: Nimbus People is a comprehensive HRIS that manages your entire employee lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding. Keep your organization aligned with centralized records, time off tracking, and interactive org charts.

addOns.name: Advanced Analytics
addOns.desc: Gain deeper insights into employee retention, diversity metrics, and compensation trends.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus People cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus People offers a Free tier for small teams, a Starter plan at $10 per user per month, and a Professional plan at $30 per user per month. Enterprise pricing is custom and available upon request.

specificFaqs.question: Can employees update their own information?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, Nimbus People includes a self-service portal where employees can safely update personal details, request time off, and access tax documents.

products.name: Nimbus Recruit
products.tagline: Attract, evaluate, and hire top talent faster.
products.summary: Nimbus Recruit is a modern applicant tracking system designed to streamline your hiring process. Create custom hiring pipelines, schedule interviews, and collaborate with your team to find the perfect candidates.

addOns.name: AI Sourcing Assistant
addOns.desc: Automatically discover and engage passive candidates matching your job descriptions.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Recruit cost?
specificFaqs.answer: We offer a Free tier for basic needs, a Starter plan at $25 per user per month, and a Professional plan at $60 per user per month. Enterprise plans are custom priced based on your organization.

specificFaqs.question: Can I post to multiple job boards at once?
specificFaqs.answer: Absolutely. Nimbus Recruit allows you to syndicate your job postings to over 50 major job boards with a single click.

products.name: Nimbus Payroll
products.tagline: Accurate, automated payroll and tax filing simplified.
products.summary: Nimbus Payroll takes the complexity out of paying your team by automating payroll runs, tax calculations, and compliance. Easily pay full-time employees and independent contractors in a few clicks.

addOns.name: International Contractor Payments
addOns.desc: Pay international contractors in their local currency across 120 countries.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Payroll cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Payroll starts with a Free tier for a few contractors, a Starter plan at $20 per user per month, and a Professional plan at $50 per user per month. Enterprise pricing is custom.

specificFaqs.question: Does Nimbus Payroll handle tax filings automatically?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, on Starter and higher plans, we automatically calculate, withhold, and file your local, state, and federal payroll taxes.

products.name: Nimbus Desk
products.tagline: Omnichannel helpdesk with powerful SLA management.
products.summary: Nimbus Desk brings all your customer conversations into a unified inbox with robust ticketing and automation.
keyFeatures: Collision detection to prevent duplicate replies
Time tracking and agent activity logs

addOns.name: Additional Storage
addOns.desc: Expand your file attachment storage capacity.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Desk cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Desk offers a Free tier for up to 3 users. Paid plans start at $20 per user per month on the Starter tier, and $50 per user per month on the Professional tier. Enterprise pricing is custom.

specificFaqs.question: Can I merge duplicate tickets?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, Nimbus Desk allows agents to easily merge duplicate tickets from the same customer to keep the conversation history clean and organized.

products.name: Nimbus Chat
products.tagline: Live chat and AI bots for instant support.
products.summary: Nimbus Chat helps you engage website visitors in real time with proactive messaging and intelligent chatbots.

addOns.name: Extra Bot Sessions
addOns.desc: Add more automated AI chatbot sessions to your monthly limit.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Chat cost?
specificFaqs.answer: The Free tier is available at no cost. Paid tiers include Starter at $15 per user per month, and Professional at $45 per user per month. Enterprise plans require custom pricing.

specificFaqs.question: Can I customize the look of the chat widget?
specificFaqs.answer: Absolutely. You can change the colors, logos, launcher icons, and welcome messages to perfectly match your brand identity.

products.name: Nimbus Knowledge
products.tagline: Empower customers with self service help centers.
products.summary: Nimbus Knowledge lets you build beautiful, searchable help centers so customers can find answers on their own.

addOns.name: Automated Translation
addOns.desc: Automatically translate your articles into up to 10 languages using AI.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Knowledge cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Knowledge is Free for up to 3 users. The Starter plan is $15 per user per month, and the Professional plan is $35 per user per month. Enterprise pricing is tailored to your needs.

specificFaqs.question: Can I host the help center on my own domain?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, starting from the Starter plan, you can map your knowledge base to a custom domain or subdomain of your choosing.

products.name: Nimbus Projects
products.tagline: Deliver projects on time with intelligent task management.
products.summary: Nimbus Projects is a comprehensive project management solution designed to help teams plan, track, and execute work efficiently. It combines intuitive task tracking with powerful resource management and timeline views.

addOns.name: Premium Client Portals
addOns.desc: White-labeled project portals for your external clients.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Projects cost?
specificFaqs.answer: We offer a Free tier for small teams, a Starter plan at $10 per user per month, a Professional plan at $30 per user per month, and custom Enterprise pricing.

specificFaqs.question: Can I track billable hours directly in the app?
specificFaqs.answer: Absolutely. Nimbus Projects includes native time tracking that syncs directly with Nimbus Invoice for seamless client billing.

products.name: Nimbus Docs
products.tagline: Collaborate on beautiful documents in real time.
products.summary: Nimbus Docs is a modern workspace for team knowledge, offering real-time collaborative editing and rich media support. It serves as your single source of truth for company wikis, meeting notes, and project documentation.

addOns.name: Nimbus Docs AI
addOns.desc: Generative AI writing assistant to summarize notes and draft content.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Docs cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Docs is free for basic use, $8 per user per month for Starter, $15 per user per month for Professional, and custom for Enterprise.

specificFaqs.question: Can I import my existing documents from other platforms?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, you can import standard formats like Word, Markdown, and text files directly into your workspaces.

products.name: Nimbus Boards
products.tagline: Visualize workflows with intuitive kanban and online whiteboards.
products.summary: Nimbus Boards provides flexible visual workspaces for brainstorming, sprint planning, and agile workflow management. Teams can seamlessly switch between structured kanban boards and freeform digital whiteboards.

addOns.name: Agile Coaching Templates
addOns.desc: A premium library of agile frameworks and retrospective templates.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Boards cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Pricing ranges from a Free tier to $12 per user per month for Starter, $25 for Professional, and custom Enterprise pricing.

specificFaqs.question: Can I link kanban cards to Nimbus Projects tasks?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, Nimbus Boards integrates natively with Nimbus Projects, allowing you to sync cards and tasks bidirectionally.

products.name: Nimbus Analytics
products.tagline: Self-serve business intelligence and reporting made easy.
products.summary: Nimbus Analytics empowers your team to explore data, build custom reports, and uncover actionable insights without writing code.
keyFeatures: Export to PDF, CSV, and Excel

addOns.name: Premium AI Insights
addOns.desc: Advanced machine learning forecasting and anomaly detection capabilities.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Analytics cost?
specificFaqs.answer: We offer a Free tier for basic needs, a Starter plan at $15 per user per month, a Professional plan at $45 per user per month, and custom Enterprise pricing.

specificFaqs.question: Can I embed reports in my own application?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, embedded analytics is available on the Professional and Enterprise plans.

products.name: Nimbus Dashboards
products.tagline: Real-time operational dashboards and alerts for teams.
products.summary: Monitor your vital business metrics in real time with interactive dashboards and instant alerts for critical changes.

addOns.name: Extra Alert Credits
addOns.desc: Add 500 additional SMS or webhook alerts to your monthly quota.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Dashboards cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Pricing starts with a Free tier, followed by Starter at $10 per user per month, Professional at $30 per user per month, and custom Enterprise plans.

specificFaqs.question: Can I display these dashboards on office TVs?
specificFaqs.answer: Absolutely, our dedicated TV mode optimizes the layout for large screens and automatically cycles through multiple dashboard tabs.

products.name: Nimbus DataPipe
products.tagline: No-code ETL and data integration made simple.
products.summary: Seamlessly move data between your favorite apps and data warehouses without writing a single line of code.

addOns.name: Additional Sync Volume
addOns.desc: Add 1,000,000 extra records to your monthly sync limit.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus DataPipe cost?
specificFaqs.answer: We offer a Free tier, a Starter plan at $25 per user per month, a Professional plan at $65 per user per month, and Enterprise pricing upon request.

specificFaqs.question: Which data warehouses are supported?
specificFaqs.answer: We currently support Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and PostgreSQL.

products.name: Nimbus Vault
products.tagline: Secure password and secrets management for teams.
products.summary: Nimbus Vault helps teams store, share, and manage passwords and infrastructure secrets securely. It ensures your sensitive credentials are encrypted and easily accessible only to authorized personnel.
keyFeatures: Secure password sharing and shared folders
API key and infrastructure secret storage

addOns.name: Advanced Threat Intelligence
addOns.desc: Proactively scans and alerts on compromised credentials across the dark web.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Vault cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Nimbus Vault offers a Free tier for up to 3 users, a Starter tier at 10 USD per user per month, a Professional tier at 25 USD per user per month, and custom Enterprise pricing.

specificFaqs.question: Can I recover my data if I lose my master password?
specificFaqs.answer: Because Nimbus Vault uses zero-knowledge encryption, we cannot recover your master password, but administrators can configure account recovery policies for managed users.

products.name: Nimbus SSO
products.tagline: Seamless identity and access management for business.
products.summary: Nimbus SSO provides secure single sign-on and identity management for your entire workforce. It simplifies access to all your web and mobile applications with one set of credentials.
keyFeatures: Single sign-on (SSO) for web and mobile
Integration with Active Directory and LDAP

addOns.name: Advanced Identity Protection
addOns.desc: Adds machine learning driven risk scoring to prevent unauthorized access attempts.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus SSO cost?
specificFaqs.answer: We have a Free tier for small teams, Starter at 15 USD per user per month, Professional at 35 USD per user per month, and custom Enterprise plans.

specificFaqs.question: Does Nimbus SSO support custom SAML applications?
specificFaqs.answer: Yes, you can easily configure custom SAML 2.0 and OIDC connections for any internal or third-party application.

products.name: Nimbus Endpoint
products.tagline: Comprehensive device management and endpoint security.
products.summary: Nimbus Endpoint allows IT teams to manage, secure, and monitor company-owned and bring-your-own devices from a single cloud console. It protects your endpoints against malware and unauthorized access.
keyFeatures: Cross-platform device management (Windows, Mac, iOS, Android)
Automated patch management and OS updates

addOns.name: Managed Threat Response
addOns.desc: Provides 24/7 monitoring and incident response by our team of security experts.

specificFaqs.question: What does Nimbus Endpoint cost?
specificFaqs.answer: Pricing starts with a Free tier, moves to Starter at 20 USD per user per month, Professional at 45 USD per user per month, and Enterprise for custom needs.

specificFaqs.question: Will the endpoint agent slow down employee computers?
specificFaqs.answer: No, our agent is designed to be ultra-lightweight and consumes minimal system resources during background scans.
